reason: I spend about 9,800 a year on glazing damage, all of it out of contingency. You want around 19,000 a year to prevent it, which is double what the problem costs me. It makes no sense on my margins.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it. So I would pay 19 a m2 and still carry the risk. Also 50% upfront and 150 m2 minimums on small jobs.
instead: Carry on as now: no protection, clean or replace at snagging from contingency, or buy cheap tape and film for the worst frames.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee that ACHV pays for any frame or glass damage from the coating or its removal, at a price under about 6 per m2 all-in.
